blocks.text: Captain of the *Gull's Debt* and uncrowned queen of [[Port Vellen]]'s night trade. Kestrel runs salvage, contraband, and people — always with a smile, always with a ledger. The [[The Tidewardens|Tidewardens]] have posted a bounty three times; three times it was quietly withdrawn.
Everything the sea takes comes back eventually. I just charge for delivery.

Kestrel is a paid asset of [[The Veiled Hand]] — she doesn't know their real goal, only that they pay in old-kingdom gold for anything recovered from the drowned quarter. She survived the [[Night of Broken Lanterns]] because they warned her to be at sea.
